description: List every catalog edition credited to one contributor, across all credited roles. Anonymous and read-only; served by the bibliograph edge from the catalog tables.

contributor.description: AT-URI of a net.olamaelcu.livtet.biblio.contributor record. A URI from another collection is rejected rather than looked up.

limit.description: Maximum number of editions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. A malformed cursor restarts at the beginning rather than erroring.

items.description: Editions credited to the contributor, newest catalog creation first. An edition in which the contributor holds several roles appears once.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent when no more editions are credited.

total.description: Total distinct credited editions. Present on the first page only.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: contributor is missing, malformed, or not a contributor record URI.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No catalog contributor has that URI.
